up: Retrieve all molecules (compounds) that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727832. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL molecule ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary) and its preferred name (pref_name). Also include the canonical SMILES if available from compound_structures. Deduplicate so each molecule appears only once. Do not apply any additional filters.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727832';
